title: Remove the Solitaire Collection app (Store package Microsoft.MicrosoftSolitaireCollection)
description: Removes the Microsoft Solitaire Collection Store package (Microsoft.MicrosoftSolitaireCollection) for the current user. The package is reinstallable from the Microsoft Store. On undo the package is re-registered from its install location when the files are still on disk; if they are gone, the undo result carries the documented winget identifier and the post-undo verification reports honestly that restoration was not possible.
